hero.description: Southern facade of the Palace of Justice, Church Square, Pretoria.  Its foundation stone was laid by Paul Kruger in 1897. It is currently the headquarters of the Gauteng Division of the High Court of South Africa. The Rivonia trial where Nelson Mandela, amongst others, was sentenced to life imprisonment was heard here in 1963/4.

gallery.title: File:Durban Sign 1989 (3x4 cropped).jpg
gallery.description: Sign in Durban that states the beach is for whites only under section 37 of the Durban beach by-laws. The languages are English, Afrikaans and Zulu, the language of the black population group in the Durban area.

gallery.filename: Travel diary from the Rivonia Trial (State v. Nelson Mandela and Others) 01.jpg
gallery.title: File:Travel diary from the Rivonia Trial (State v. Nelson Mandela and Others) 01.jpg
gallery.artist: Department of Justice; Supreme Court of South Africa (Transvaal Provinical Division)
gallery.description:
This material has been uploaded to WikiCommons by the Nelson Mandela Foundation. It is part of the Rivonia Trial Prosecution Papers -  we offer the Wikipedia community an opportunity to explore, through Mandela’s own hand, the journey he took to several African countries and to London before he was arrested and sentenced to life imprisonment. 
Digital copies of the full Rivonia Trial Prosecution Papers are held by Nelson Mandela Centre of Memory, National Archives and Records Service of South Africa, and Brenthurst Library.
categories: Travel diary from the Rivonia Trial
